maya-pm: Quick sync — putting together the final integrated GTM checklist for the marketplace launch. Need quick signoffs on press timing, partner assets, and the staggered landing page rollouts. Who's got urgent blockers?
lia-marketing: I'm good on copy and the blog draft — sharing link in a sec. Need logo variants from hardware partners (SVG + PNG) and final hero screenshot.
sam-sales: Sales ask: confirm availability in Azure + GCP listings day-1. Also need partner co-selling blurb for partner portal.
oliver-partner: Nimbus Systems will provide logos + short blurb by EOD. One asks: can we delay their mention in press by 24h due to their embargo?
maya-pm: Noted. We have two embargo windows: global press at 2025-09-10 16:00 UTC, partner spotlight (Nimbus) at 2025-09-11 16:00 UTC. Lia — can the blog + landing page respect that split?
lia-marketing: Yes — we'll have a staging landing with generic partner mention for day-1 and then swap in Nimbus content on day+1. Ops will need the feature flag.
devon-ops: I'll add a `partner_spotlight` feature-flag and a route param. Plan: `FF=partner_spotlight: off` day-0, flip on at 2025-09-11 16:05 UTC. Pushing an infra PR now.
maya-pm: Perfect. Also need to confirm SI integrations messaging — are we showing 'pre-integrated with AcmeSI' or 'integration available via marketplace' copy? Sam?
sam-sales: For enterprise prospects let's call out 'pre-validated integrations with AcmeSI' in the partner portal. On public landing we'll use 'integration available via marketplace' to keep it generic.
oliver-partner: Legal asked for a short attribution line for Nimbus: "Nimbus Systems is a certified infrastructure partner of Redwood Inference." I'll attach the approved text.
lia-marketing: Copy accepted. Two asks: (1) press release needs one customer quote — can DevRel pull a beta customer quote by tomorrow? (2) Design needs final hero image with real console screenshot — @devon-ops can you coordinate secure screenshot capture?
devon-ops: Yep. Will coordinate with security to redact identifiable tokens and deliver hero PNG by EOD tomorrow.
maya-pm: Tiny checklist snippet I'm pasting — confirm status (Y/N).

```
- Press release: draft complete (lia) — STATUS: draft
- Embargo schedule: set (maya) — STATUS: set
- Partner logos: Nimbus + others — STATUS: promised
- Landing page staging: feature flag ready (devon) — STATUS: in progress
- Blog post: draft (lia) — STATUS: review
- Marketplace listings: Azure/GCP packaging (sam) — STATUS: pending
- SI integration blurb: approved (sam) — STATUS: approved
- Customer quote: ask out to Beta customers (devrel) — STATUS: requested
- Legal signoff on partner text (legal) — STATUS: requested
```

maya-pm: I'll treat anything not marked approved as blocker. Sam — can you confirm marketplace packaging ETA?
sam-sales: Packaging ETA: 2025-09-09 for Azure SKU + test listing, 2025-09-09 for GCP listing draft. Need final logos and legal text by EOD 2025-09-07.
lia-marketing: Also note: press-bot will run the embargo tracking. @press-bot can you create the embargo event?
press-bot: Embargo event created: id=EMB-20250910-01. Notifications scheduled to: @press@redwood.com, @partners@redwood.com at 2025-09-10 15:30 UTC for final checks.
maya-pm: Great — last item: post-launch rollback plan if marketplace listing fails validation. Devon, can we have a hotfix route to remove marketplace CTA from landing within 15 minutes?
devon-ops: Yep. Will add a fast rollback webhook and a one-click toggle in the runbook. I’ll add runbook snippet to the release doc.
lia-marketing: I'm slotting the blog publish for 2025-09-10 16:05 UTC (5 mins after press), landing page flip at 16:15 UTC to let listings propagate. Is everyone aligned?
oliver-partner: Nimbus OK with those times. Will hold embargo on their side until our day+1 spotlight.
maya-pm: Thanks team. Action items recap: Nimbus logos + legal text (Oliver) by EOD 9/7; DevRel to chase customer quote by 9/8; Devon to finish flag + runbook by 9/9; Sam to complete marketplace packaging by 9/9. If no objections, I'll lock the schedule in tomorrow morning. :calendar: :rocket:
lia-marketing: No objections. :thumbsup:
sam-sales: 👍
noliver-partner: 👍
devon-ops: ACK
press-bot: Reminder scheduled 2025-09-09 09:00 UTC: preflight checklist reminder to @launch-cd.
